title: Peloton Metric1 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=peloton:metric1
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day peloton metric1 (1) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on peloton metric1 (1) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It finds what time of day your peloton metric1 (1) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
